description: Authoritative data contract for high-fidelity HTML and Unity reproduction. HTML writers and Unity writers consume generated blueprint.fidelityContract instances; runtime bridge infra must not carry fixture constants.

versionPolicy.schemaVersion: Version of this schema document. Bump on structural changes to this file.
versionPolicy.contractVersion: Version of generated fidelityContract instance semantics. Bump when required roots, writer gates, or consumer semantics change.
versionPolicy.v1_1_0_notes: Adds entities[].worldLabel (optional, polymorphic) and relaxes hud[].text to polymorphic. Polymorphic shape: string OR {default?: string, perPhase: Record<phaseId,string>}. Lib field-diff @0.6.1 reads v1.0.0 instances via transitional hud[id^="label."] fallback into worldLabel bucket; migration script scripts/migrate-v1.0-to-v1.1.cjs moves them forward.
versionPolicy.v1_2_0_notes: Adds phases[].cameraTransform (informative) + phases[].projectedAnchors (normative, blocking) to make per-phase screen-space projection the canonical visual closure truth. Opt1 falsification (msg=ee995411) proved cameraTransform alone insufficient — Three.js↔PlayCanvas world coord/projection semantics are not equivalent. projectedAnchors carry source-observed 2D screen rects (viewport baseline 1280×720, origin top-left) so target writers calibrate via local screen-space fit instead of replaying source camera math. Lib field-diff @0.7.0 reads v1.1.0 instances via transitional fallback: projectedAnchors absent → unresolvedFidelityGaps[] advisory entry; cameraTransform absent → inferred-default. v1.1.0 instances continue to load. Migration script scripts/migrate-v1.1-to-v1.2.cjs is backfill-only: accepts 1.1.0 or 1.2.0 input, runs anchor-extractor against source HTML if available, fills projectedAnchors; if source HTML absent, leaves contract + unresolvedFidelityGaps advisory (NO fabrication). Idempotent. Conditional schemaVersion bump: bumps 1.1.0 → 1.2.0 only if every phase has projectedAnchors populated with provenance ∈ {extracted, anchor-only} (no inferred-default entries).
versionPolicy.v1_3_0_notes: Adds source-HTML-derived presentation field family — all OPTIONAL on the contract surface, populated by scripts/migrate-v1.2-to-v1.3.cjs from reverse-extracted JS literals: (1) scene.backgroundColor [r,g,b] linear-RGB 0..1 from SCENE_CONFIG.backgroundColor (writer overlay clear color); (2) entities[].worldLabel rich record {text, worldOffset:{x,y,z}, color?, fontSize?, consumer?} extracted from ENTITY_STYLE[id].label (writer renders sprite at entity.position + worldOffset). v1.1 polymorphic-text form (string OR {default?, perPhase}) is still accepted for the legacy non-3D HUD case — validator dispatches on (typeof text === 'string' && isPlainObject(worldOffset)); (3) entities[].primitiveStyle {modelRef:string, baseColor:[r,g,b] linear, baseColorHex?:string} from ENTITY_STYLE[id].{kind,color} — modelRef is a semantic kind hint (astronaut|ship|base|station|counter|pad|crystal|debris|cargo|beacon|gate) consumed by the writer overlay to pick a styled mesh family instead of falling back to procedural box/cylinder. v1.2 instances continue to load unchanged. Migration script is deterministic regex parse of source HTML (no puppeteer); idempotent (preserves existing worldLabel/primitiveStyle unless forceReextract=true). Conditional schemaVersion bump: bumps 1.2.0 → 1.3.0 only when scene.backgroundColor extracted AND every source-declared entity has both worldLabel and primitiveStyle populated (Unity-internal auxiliary entities absent from source HTML are excluded — they surface as advisoryGaps[] kind='v13-entity-not-in-source'). Pipeline integration: engine/stages/fidelity-contract-produce.cjs chains v1.1→v1.2 then v1.2→v1.3 migrate in createLunaPipeline (test/luna-pipeline-composition.test.cjs pins position). Two new field-diff buckets (scene + primitiveStyle) are BLOCKING by design — writer overlay #46 must consume modelRef + baseColor to clear them.
versionPolicy.v1_4_0_notes: Single-axis hud polymorphic enforcement (task #52 v1.4d-ε). Diagnostic on post-#45/#46 main confirmed 22 hud field-diffs are all phase-text mismatches in 3 slots — hud.phase / hud.tip / hud.targethint — because the v1.3 contract authored these as phase-static plain strings (only phase1 values). Runtime DOM / extractor correctly emit per-phase strings; field-diff resolvePolymorphicText is already shape-aware. The break is at Stage 1 (contract authoring) alone. v1.4d migration scripts/migrate-v1.3-to-v1.4d.cjs reverse-extracts source HTML PHASES array (deterministic regex; no puppeteer) and folds {id, guideText} per phase into polymorphic {perPhase: {phaseId: text}} records for those 3 hud slots: hud.phase = 'Phase N/8' (derived from index), hud.tip = guideText verbatim, hud.targethint = '目标：' + guideText. Other hud entries (hud.label.*, hud.iceHud, hud.oxygenHud, hud.coinHud, hud.scrapHud, hud.toolHud, hud:steptoast) untouched. SEVERITY POLICY: for the 3 polymorphic-eligible hud ids, plain-string text is treated as DEPRECATED-but-LEGAL (advisory, not blocking) to preserve backward-compat with v0.5/v1.0~v1.3 contracts authored as static phase1 strings — see hudPolymorphicEligibleIds in hudContract block. Migration is idempotent (preserves existing {perPhase:...} records unless forceReextract=true). Conditional schemaVersion bump: bumps 1.3.0 → 1.4.0 only when all 3 polymorphic-eligible slots are either successfully rewritten or already polymorphic AND phases array non-empty. Pipeline integration: engine/stages/fidelity-contract-produce.cjs chains v1.2→v1.3 then v1.3→v1.4d migrate in createLunaPipeline (test/luna-pipeline-composition.test.cjs pins position). No new field-diff bucket — the existing hud bucket clears 22→0 once the polymorphic instance lands.

capabilityPolicy.writerRule: Every writer must declare supportedCapabilities. Missing support is a hard fail before asset/code emission.

coordinateSystem.description: Coordinates are explicit because source Three.js RH and Unity LH differ.

rendererAdapter.description: Driver-level mapping bucket. Fidelity data lives in the shared roots; unavoidable renderer/runtime mappings live here.
rendererAdapter.consumerRule: Each generated contract field may declare consumer: ["html", "unity", "report"]. Driver-specific translation details stay under rendererAdapter.{three,unity}.

provenance.description: Field-level provenance for reverse extraction and conflict decisions.

entityContract.idPolicy: SourcePrimitive_<Entity>_<NN> is common but not required. Reverse extractors must also carry non-SourcePrimitive material families such as TargetRing_Mat, TrailLine_Mat, and LaserLine_Mat.

worldLabelPolicy.shape: v1.1 polymorphic-text: string | {default?: string, perPhase: Record<phaseId,string>}  ||  v1.3 rich record: {text:string, worldOffset:{x:number,y:number,z:number}, color?:string, fontSize?:number, consumer?:Array<string>}
worldLabelPolicy.semantics: World-space label rendered on/over the entity in 3D (e.g. Three.js Sprite + DOM overlay in source HTML). Distinct from hud[] which is screen-space HUD overlay. Diff bucket = worldLabel-{missing,mismatch}; non-blocking advisory at v1.1, BLOCKING at v1.3 when primitiveStyle is populated (writer #46 must place sprite at entity.position + worldOffset).
worldLabelPolicy.shapeDispatch: Validator engines dispatch on (typeof value.text === 'string' && isPlainObject(value.worldOffset)) → v1.3 rich record path; otherwise → v1.1 polymorphic-text path. Both shapes coexist on the v1.3 contract surface.
worldLabelPolicy.v1_0_migration: v1.0.0 contracts carried world labels as hud[id="label.<EntityName>"] entries with role:"entity-label". v1.1 migration moves them to entities[id=<EntityName>].worldLabel; orphans (no matching entity) remain in hud[] with unresolvedFidelityGaps[] warning.
worldLabelPolicy.v1_3_migration: scripts/migrate-v1.2-to-v1.3.cjs reverse-extracts label text + worldOffset (default offset y=3.1 above entity center) from source HTML ENTITY_STYLE[id].label literal. Preserves existing v1.1 polymorphic-text values unless forceReextract=true.

primitiveStylePolicy.semantics: Semantic mesh-kind hint + per-entity tint for writer overlay (task #46) to render styled mesh+material instead of procedural box/cylinder fallback. modelRef enum: astronaut|ship|base|station|counter|pad|crystal|debris|cargo|beacon|gate. baseColor is linear-RGB to compose directly with PlayCanvas StandardMaterial. Diff bucket = primitiveStyle-{missing,mismatch}; BLOCKING by design — the writer overlay MUST consume these fields when present.
primitiveStylePolicy.v1_3_extraction: scripts/migrate-v1.2-to-v1.3.cjs parses ENTITY_STYLE[id].{kind,color} from source HTML JS literals. Unknown kinds are passed through as-is (modelRef = kind) and tracked in report.unknownModelKinds for writer fallback logging.

uiOverlayContract.semantics: Screen-space UI scaffold discovered in the source HTML, such as CTA button, Canvas, floating joystick background and handle. These are not world-space entities and should not become entity-extra phantom blockers when a target extractor reports them through the runtime scene graph. They remain visible UI signals handled by HUD/visual checks.
uiOverlayContract.diffPolicy: field-diff suppresses entity-extra for ids explicitly listed here only; this is not a generic runtime skip-list.

phaseContract.description: Behavior must be shifted left too: phase visibility, trigger evidence, and auto/manual gates are shared by HTML and Unity. v1.2 adds cameraTransform (informative) + projectedAnchors (normative, blocking) — see cameraTransformShape and projectedAnchorsShape.
phaseContract.versionConditionalEnforcement: cameraTransform + projectedAnchors are enforced only when schemaVersion >= 1.2.0. v1.0/v1.1 instances continue to validate without these keys (acceptedInstanceSchemaVersions covers backward-compat read path).

cameraTransformShape.description: Per-phase camera world-space pose. INFORMATIVE/DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — not blocking visual closure. Use cases: (1) writer initial camera setup, (2) diagnostic when projectedAnchors drift, (3) future renderer hint when projectedAnchors are absent. Renderer-agnostic.

shape.lookAt: vec3 OR { mode: 'entity', entityId: string } OR { mode: 'expression', expr: string }
shape.fov: number — field of view in degrees (perspective only)

projectedAnchorsShape.description: Per-phase, per-entity source-observed screen-space rect. NORMATIVE / BLOCKING. Captured by running source Three.js renderer + camera.project() against each visible entity's world AABB → 8-vertex screen projection → axis-aligned 2D bbox. Target writers consume these as ground-truth screen targets for local PlayCanvas/Luna screen-space calibration. Target writers MUST NOT iframe-replay source.
projectedAnchorsShape.polymorphism_note: v1.2.0 first ship is flat-per-phase (Jonny msg=892495cc / Sam preference). Default/perPhase polymorphic resolver deferred — phases[] is already phase-scoped so flat captures the model. Revisit only if cross-viewport / cross-default semantics emerge.

viewportBaseline.rationale: Matches engine/stages/fidelity-source-diff.cjs DEFAULT_VIEWPORT={1280,720} + sharp resize/cover pixel-diff baseline + Luna/PlayCanvas DOM canvas convention. Top-left origin matches DOM/image-pixel y-down convention used by sharp + html2canvas downstream.

<entityId>.depth_ndc: number OPTIONAL — center-z in NDC [-1, 1], for occlusion-order diagnostics
<entityId>.matchedAlias: OPTIONAL audit — source Three.js .name actually matched

projectedAnchorsShape.validatorForbiddenKeysRationale: Derived diagnostic booleans are PoC/migration-report-only. Writer and field-diff derive viewportIntersection at consume time from x_px/y_px/w_px/h_px via the bbox-rect ∩ viewport-rect formula against viewportBaseline. Persisting these would couple historical contracts to viewport constants and violate the v6.1 persistence boundary (Jonny msg=0ec2b725 / Tim msg=52fe75ad).
projectedAnchorsShape.bboxSourceRule: source-side entity world AABB → 8 vertex × camera matrix → NDC → viewport transform → screen min/max → axis-aligned 2D rect. extractor MUST handle Three.js Object3D.matrixWorld + Camera.matrixWorldInverse + Camera.projectionMatrix in this order. for entities without geometry (e.g. labels), bbox = label DOM rect or fallback to anchor-only (w_px=0, h_px=0, provenance='anchor-only').
projectedAnchorsShape.showEntitiesCoupling: phases[i].projectedAnchors MUST contain a key for every entityId in phases[i].showEntities (1:1 enforcement, per Jonny review point 2). missing key → schema VALIDATION blocking; present key with provenance='inferred-default' → unresolvedFidelityGaps[] advisory (writer still gets calibration target, just lower confidence).
projectedAnchorsShape.emptyShowEntitiesRule: When showEntities[] is empty, projectedAnchors MUST still be present (it is in phaseContract.requiredKeys) but as an empty object {}. Validator accepts {} as trivially satisfying the 1:1 coupling. Omitting the projectedAnchors key entirely fails validation in v1.2.0+ instances (per Tim msg=7caa6ec8 clarification, locked).
projectedAnchorsShape.tolerance: writer-side anchor diff: ±8px absolute on x_px/y_px/w_px/h_px (configurable via fidelity-source-diff stage env DEFAULT_ANCHOR_PIXEL_TOLERANCE). Beyond tolerance → blocking field-diff entry. Exception: when expected anchor's derived viewportIntersection=false (source-positioned-offscreen), anchor-mismatch downgrades to advisory unresolvedFidelityGaps[] with kind='anchor-mismatch-off-viewport', NOT hasBlockingDiff (Jonny msg=0ec2b725 / Tim msg=52fe75ad). Pixel-gate hard <5% covers off-canvas regions via sharp resize/cover.
projectedAnchorsShape.consumerDerivedViewportIntersection: viewportIntersection = (x_px + w_px) >= 0 AND x_px <= viewportBaseline.width AND (y_px + h_px) >= 0 AND y_px <= viewportBaseline.height. Bbox-rect ∩ viewport-rect (NOT center-point). Derived in-memory at consume time by writer and field-diff; NEVER persisted in contract.

sceneContract.v1_3_notes: Top-level scene-level fields populated by v1.3 producer chain. Optional on the contract surface — pre-v1.3 contracts omit the entire scene block. v1.3 instances typically populate at least scene.backgroundColor from source HTML SCENE_CONFIG.backgroundColor reverse-extraction.

shape.backgroundColor: OPTIONAL — [r,g,b] linear-RGB 0..1. Writer overlay (#46) consumes as camera clearColor / canvas background.
shape.backgroundColorHex: OPTIONAL — original 6-char hex (e.g. '071026') for audit/debug round-trip.

sceneContract.diffPolicy: field-diff scene bucket is BLOCKING: scene-missing emits when contract.scene.backgroundColor present but observed scene.backgroundColor undefined; scene-mismatch emits on componentwise drift outside FLOAT_EPSILON. Pre-v1.3 contracts (no scene block) produce no scene-bucket entries.

hudContract.textResolverPolicy: Lib field-diff @0.6.1 resolution order: perPhase[phaseId] > default > undefined (skip diff for this phase). Q3 tolerance: expected '' and observed undefined treated as match.
hudContract.rolePolicy: role:"entity-label" + id:"label.<EntityName>" is the v1.0.0 transitional shape for world-space labels; v1.1 forward expresses these as entities[].worldLabel and treats them as a separate diff bucket.
hudContract.hudPolymorphicPolicy: v1.4d (task #52) — the 3 ids in hudPolymorphicEligibleIds are phase-dynamic at runtime (source HTML phaseTimeline tick rewrites their textContent every phase). v1.4.0 instances MUST author these as polymorphic {perPhase: {phaseId: string}} records covering all source-declared phases. Plain-string text for these ids in pre-v1.4 instances stays LEGAL (backward-compat read path via acceptedInstanceSchemaVersions) but is DEPRECATED — field-diff treats the resulting per-phase mismatches as ADVISORY (blocking:false) for v0.5/v1.0~v1.3 contracts (schemaVersion < 1.4.0), BLOCKING for v1.4.0+ contracts where plain-string is an authoring bug. Other hud ids (hud.iceHud, hud.oxygenHud, hud.coinHud, hud.scrapHud, hud.toolHud, hud.label.*, hud:steptoast) accept either shape with no severity downgrade.

unityCoverage.rule: Pure HTML fixtures may use missing, but Unity writers must fail unless explicitly allowed during migration.

writerFailFast.unresolvedFidelityGaps: Any gap with blocking !== false blocks writer emission.
writerFailFast.contractConflicts: Any conflict without resolution.status=accepted|rejected|deferred blocks writer emission.
fallbackPolicy: Delivery__*.mat entries must be recorded as unresolvedFidelityGaps unless intentionally mapped with provenance and resolution
No fixture constants inside Luna bridge/runtime infra

roundTripPolicy.description: HTML/Unity writer readback must diff against the source contract before final delivery.
roundTripPolicy.hardGate: Readback diff must be zero for required data roots. Visual screenshot/VLM diff is advisory after this gate.
